snippet.title: SHADE Protocol - Kickstarter Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Follow us on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/littlelegendary/shade-protocol
Wishlist Now on Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581730/SHADE_Protocol/
Sign up to Playtest: https://www.littlelegendary.com/
Join our Discord Community: https://discord.com/invite/MDKsvFPuVG

SHADE Protocol is a 2D Cyber-Nostalgic Metroidvania where you cut, break, and shift the rules of the universe around you to defeat epic bosses, explore a futuristic world, and save humanity from extinction!
